pass_a_gloss: Sons of the slain reckoned promise-seed; Mt 10:37-39 cost and gain.
pass_b_english: 'Take thought for the sons of the slain' (Psalm 79:11 (LXX 78)) — for your seed, Ambrose, shall be reckoned though slain with you: 'for not the children of the flesh are children of God, but the children of the promise are reckoned for seed.' (Romans 9:8) If you love son or daughter more than Christ, you are not worthy; but loving Christ more, you gain them too — for 'he who loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me. And he who taketh not his cross and followeth me is not worthy of me. He that findeth his soul shall lose it; and he that loseth his soul for my sake shall find it.' (Matthew 10:37–39) (Psalm 79:11)
